items.claim: I could use 4 of 9 parking sites this time.
items.reason: Parking quality shows 9 total sites and 4 usable ones.

items.claim: Across those four, a typical weekday was emptier overnight and became fuller through the morning, reaching 48.6% at 12:00 before easing back.
items.reason: The 4-site typical weekday profile is lower overnight, rises to 48.6% at 12:00, then declines afterward.

items.claim: The quietest point of the day was 03:00 at 23.8%.
items.reason: The typical weekday trough is 03:00 at 23.8%.

items.claim: Weekend behaviour was not uniform across sites.
items.reason: The pooled parking test says weekend effects differ between series.

items.claim: Tiefgarage Hotel Maritim was emptier on weekends by 13.5 percentage points, and Tiefgarage Ulrichshaus was emptier by 15.0 percentage points.
items.reason: Both sites have significant weekend effects of -13.5 and -15.0 percentage points.

items.claim: Elbauenpark - Messeparkplatz and Tiefgarage Friedensplatz showed no measurable weekend change.
items.reason: Both weekend effects are marked significant false.

items.claim: Compared with August, only Tiefgarage Friedensplatz was fuller, by 4.1 percentage points at equal hour and weekday; its raw mean moved from 26.6% to 31.3%.
items.reason: Friedensplatz is the only series marked significantly higher, with a +4.1 adjusted shift and mean rising from 26.6% to 31.3%.

items.claim: Elbauenpark - Messeparkplatz, Tiefgarage Hotel Maritim, and Tiefgarage Ulrichshaus showed no measurable change.
items.reason: All three month-on-month adjusted shifts are marked significant false.

items.claim: I had usable data from 17 of 18 charging stations.
items.reason: The quality section lists 17 usable stations out of 18 total.

items.claim: On a typical weekday, occupancy was lowest at 03:00 with 6.7%, climbed through the morning, and peaked at 11:00 with 39.8%.
items.reason: The typical weekday profile has its trough at 03:00 with 6.7% and its peak at 11:00 with 39.8%, with morning values rising toward that peak.

items.claim: After that it eased through the afternoon and evening.
items.reason: After the 11:00 peak, the typical weekday profile is generally lower through the afternoon and evening.

items.claim: Weekend behaviour varied from station to station.
items.reason: The pooled test says weekend effects differ between stations.

items.claim: Some stations were less busy on weekends, while many showed no measurable weekend change.
items.reason: Two stations have significant negative weekend effects, while most stations have weekend_effect.significant set to false.

items.claim: For the 15 stations I could compare with August, 4 were busier, 1 was less busy, and 10 showed no measurable change.
items.reason: The comparison summary shows 15 comparable stations: 4 significantly higher, 1 significantly lower, and 10 with no significant change.

items.claim: The clearest rise was at Leipziger Straße 45, which was busier by 16.7 percentage points at equal hour and weekday; its raw mean moved from 9.1% to 25.6%.
items.reason: Leipziger Straße 45 has the largest positive adjusted shift at 16.7 points, and its mean rises from 9.1% to 25.6%.

items.claim: Hegelstraße 4 was also busier by 13.9 percentage points, and it had no free point for 34.5% of known time.
items.reason: Hegelstraße 4 has a significant adjusted increase of 13.9 points and a busy_all_points_pct of 34.5%.

items.claim: One station moved the other way: Julius-Bremer-Straße 1 was less busy by 9.0 percentage points.
items.reason: Julius-Bremer-Straße 1 is the only significantly lower station, at -9.0 percentage points.

items.claim: For NO2, all 4 stations were usable.
items.reason: FACTS lists 4 NO2 stations, all usable, with none excluded.

items.claim: Across them, a typical weekday was lowest at 04:00 with 12.8 µg/m³ and highest at 21:00 with 30.0 µg/m³.
items.reason: The NO2 typical weekday trough is 04:00 at 12.8 µg/m³ and the peak is 21:00 at 30.0 µg/m³.

items.claim: Weekend NO2 was lower at Guericke Strasse by 5.1 µg/m³ and at Schleinufer by 5.9 µg/m³, while City Tunnel and West showed no measurable weekend change.
items.reason: Guericke Strasse and Schleinufer have significant negative weekend effects, while City Tunnel and West do not.

items.claim: No NO2 station exceeded the EU hourly limit of 200 µg/m³.
items.reason: All four NO2 stations have 0 hours over the EU hourly limit.

items.claim: The WHO daily guideline of 25 µg/m³ was exceeded on 11 days at City Tunnel, 11 days at Schleinufer, 8 days at Guericke Strasse, and 1 day at West.
items.reason: The daily WHO NO2 guideline exceedance counts match all four stations named.

items.claim: Compared with August, no NO2 station showed a measurable change.
items.reason: All four NO2 stations are listed under no significant change, with none higher or lower.

items.claim: For O3, West was the only usable station.
items.reason: FACTS shows one O3 station in total, West, and it is usable.

items.claim: A typical weekday there was lowest at 08:00 with 36.4 µg/m³ and highest at 18:00 with 86.7 µg/m³.
items.reason: West has its O3 trough at 08:00 with 36.4 µg/m³ and peak at 18:00 with 86.7 µg/m³.

items.claim: Weekend O3 showed no measurable change.
items.reason: West's O3 weekend effect is marked significant: false.

items.claim: The EU 8-hour target of 120 µg/m³ was not exceeded.
items.reason: The EU O3 8-hour target is 120 µg/m³ and West recorded 0 days over it.

items.claim: The WHO 8-hour guideline of 100 µg/m³ was exceeded on 4 days, with a worst 8-hour mean of 106.6 µg/m³.
items.reason: West exceeded the WHO O3 8-hour guideline on 4 days and the worst 8-hour mean was 106.6 µg/m³.

items.claim: Compared with August, West was cleaner by 15.3 µg/m³ at equal hour and weekday; the raw mean moved from 73.4 to 58.3 µg/m³.
items.reason: West's adjusted month-on-month shift is a significant -15.3 µg/m³, and the raw mean changed from 73.4 to 58.3 µg/m³.

items.claim: I could not use any PM10 station: GuerickeStrasse, Schleinufer, and West were excluded because the value stayed unchanged from the previous hour in 55%, 52%, and 62% of hours.
items.reason: All three PM10 stations were excluded and each exclusion reason is the stated stale-value percentage.

items.claim: I could not use any PM2.5 station for the same reason: GuerickeStrasse, Schleinufer, and West stayed unchanged from the previous hour in 64%, 63%, and 70% of hours.
items.reason: All three PM2.5 stations were excluded for stale values, at 64%, 63%, and 70% unchanged hours respectively.
